related: monocarboxylate (lactate, pyruvate, mevalonate) uptake/efflux porter activity

definition: Enables the transfer of mevalonate from one side of a membrane to the other. Mevalonate is the anion of mevalonic acid; its (R)-enantiomer is a strategic intermediate derived from hydroxymethylglutaryl-CoA in the biosynthesis of polyprenyl compounds.
label: mevalonate transmembrane transporter activity
